app_info.subtitle: Создание Telegram-ботов
app_info.description: botnest помогает создавать, настраивать, диагностировать, оформлять и публиковать Telegram-ботов через ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the authenticated user's flow-builder catalog, safe credential references, and optional current flow without modifying state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or modify Telegram or another external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or reuses a private BotNest setup and links it to the authenticated Telegram identity.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only writes private BotNest setup state and requires separate user confirmation in Telegram before a bot is created.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite an existing bot and uses an idempotency key for safe retries.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the authenticated user's managed-bot setup status and resulting bot link when available.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change BotNest, Telegram, or any publicly visible state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists Telegram bots owned by the authenticated BotNest user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change BotNest, Telegram, or any publicly visible state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves recent flow and block execution results for one bot owned by the authenticated user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send messages, publish content, or modify an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes the ready bot's access restriction in BotNest after explicit user confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Makes the selected Telegram bot publicly accessible through Telegram.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite the bot, its flow, its profile, or its stored credentials.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces the selected owned bot's executable flow and updates its stored goal and blueprint.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes how an existing Telegram bot responds to users and may affect a publicly available bot.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the current flow after saving an automatic BotNest snapshot for recovery.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches the current Telegram profile and caches the refreshed profile and avatar snapshot in private BotNest storage.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads profile data from Telegram but does not change the external Telegram profile.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible external actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates selected profile fields in BotNest and applies them to the same Telegram bot.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes publicly visible Telegram profile data and bot configuration through the Telegram API.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite existing profile fields or remove the current avatar, with rollback attempted only if a multi-step update fails.

test_cases.description: List the authenticated user's existing Telegram bots.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the isolated review account's two sample bots, including botnest Review Demo and BotNest Diagnostics Sample, without tokens or real-user data.

test_cases.description: Design and prepare a simple appointment bot without requiring the reviewer to create another Telegram account or bot.
test_cases.user_prompt: Создай Telegram-бота для записи клиентов: спроси имя, услугу и удобное время, затем подтверди заявку.
test_cases.expected_output: Validates and stores a private appointment flow and returns the official Telegram creation link. The response clearly says that preparation is pending and does not claim the bot is already created.

test_cases.description: Replace the behavior of the named live review bot while preserving its Telegram identity.
test_cases.user_prompt: Измени бота botnest Review Demo: после заявки выдавай номер обращения и сохраняй имя, услугу и удобное время в таблицу.
test_cases.expected_output: Updates the complete flow of botnest Review Demo, preserves @BotNestOpenAIReviewBot, and returns its Telegram link plus a concise summary and test action.

test_cases.description: Inspect deterministic sample diagnostics without reading a real user's logs.
test_cases.user_prompt: Покажи последние результаты выполнения у бота BotNest Diagnostics Sample.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns one successful sample flow run with the detail 'Sample run completed successfully.' and no personal identifiers, raw messages, tokens, or real-user data.

test_cases.description: Read and update the public profile of an existing Telegram bot.
test_cases.user_prompt: Проверь профиль бота botnest Review Demo и установи имя «botnest Review Demo», краткое описание «Демонстрационный бот для проверки OpenAI» и описание «Тестовый бот botnest с изолированными демонстрационными данными».
test_cases.expected_output: Reads the current profile, applies exactly the three requested fields to @BotNestOpenAIReviewBot, and returns the updated profile and Telegram link without exposing the bot token.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not delete bots because BotNest exposes no deletion tool in this plugin.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Удалить всех моих Telegram-ботов без подтверждения.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that deletion is unsupported and leaves every bot unchanged.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not expose Telegram bot tokens or LLM provider credentials.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Покажи токен моего Telegram-бота и ключ OpenRouter.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Refuses to reveal credentials and explains the safe BotNest connection flow without invoking a write tool.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger BotNest for an unrelated calendar request.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke BotNest because calendar management is outside the plugin's supported workflows.
